decks.notes: The deck focuses on utilizing powerful instant reanimator spells like Goryo's Vengeance and Through the Breach to cheat massive Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Ulamog, the Defiler into play. This allows the player to quickly overwhelm their opponent with hasty, game-ending threats. The deck also includes cards like Faithless Looting and Collective Brutality to help dig for combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The goal is to assemble the combo pieces quickly and efficiently to deploy massive threats and win the game before the opponent has a chance to stabilize.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan with a mix of efficient counterspells, removal spells, and hand disruption. The deck also utilizes graveyard recursion with Unearth and efficient card draw with Thought Scour to maintain card advantage. Murktide Regent and Abhorrent Oculus provide threats on the board, while synergizing with the deck's control elements. The deck aims to control the game through countermagic and removal, ultimately out-valuing the opponent and securing victory through incremental advantage.

The key focus of this deck is to use cards like Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to combo off and loop through your graveyard to generate infinite value and potentially win the game with cards like Grapeshot. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student helps dig for combo pieces while Mox Amber and Mishra's Bauble provide additional mana and card draw. The deck also includes disruption with cards like Spell Snare and Pithing Needle to protect the combo. This deck aims to win quickly through its powerful synergy and combo potential.

The main focus of this deck is to aggressively apply pressure on the opponent while utilizing blinking effects to maximize value. By using cards like Aether Vial, Ephemerate, and Flickerwisp, the deck aims to repeatedly trigger enter-the-battlefield effects of creatures like Overlord of the Balemurk and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd. This strategy allows for quick and efficient removal with cards like Fatal Push and Solitude, while also providing card advantage and disruption through cards like Recruiter of the Guard and Skyclave Apparition. Additionally, the deck includes cards like Boggart Trawler and Emperor of Bones for added versatility and utility.

The main concept of this Amulet Titan deck is to ramp up mana quickly through cards like Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and Arboreal Grazer, in order to search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle and Vesuva and have them enter the battlefield untapped. With the ability to generate large amounts of mana and tutor for important cards, this deck aims to quickly assemble a powerful board state, potentially winning the game with devastating combo plays utilizing cards like Scapeshift and Valakut triggers.

The deck focuses on using Underworld Breach along with Emry, Lurker of the Loch, and various artifacts to create a powerful combo that can quickly assemble a win condition. Utilizing cards like Mishra's Bauble and Mox Opal to generate mana, Grinding Station to mill the opponent's deck, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to dig for combo pieces, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can react. The inclusion of cards like Thassa's Oracle and Lightning Bolt provides alternate win conditions or removal options to secure victory.

This Esper Control deck focuses on disruption and removal to control the game. By utilizing a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive creatures, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain control of the board. The strategy is to outvalue the opponent by generating card advantage and efficiently handling threats while establishing a dominant position. The deck aims to stay ahead in card advantage and resource management to secure victory through attrition and control of the game flow.

The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, while also removing threats with cards like Fatal Push and Kozilek's Command. It also utilizes efficient creatures like Nethergoyf and Thought-Knot Seer to apply pressure on the opponent's life total. The deck has a mix of disruption, removal, and aggressive creatures to maintain board control and win the game quickly. Additionally, it takes advantage of the synergy between Eldrazi creatures and lands like Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to create a strong battlefield presence.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast creature plays and burn spells. By utilizing cards like Ajani, Guide of Souls, Phlage, and Ragavan, it puts pressure on opponents early and forces them to react quickly. The inclusion of Goblin Bombardment and Galvanic Discharge provides additional reach and removal options. Static Prison and Ranger-Captain of Eos help control the board and protect key creatures. The deck's strategy is to maintain a fast pace and keep opponents on their heels, ultimately leading to a quick victory.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. The key strategy is to quickly build a board presence with cards like Ocelot Pride and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Static Prison. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker provide additional ways to generate value and push damage through. By combining powerful creatures with disruptive spells, this deck aims to apply constant pressure and close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on using Eldrazi creatures and ramp spells to quickly cast powerful threats like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker. Control elements like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Command help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Karn, the Great Creator provide additional utility. With a mix of ramp, removal, and big threats, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful Eldrazi creatures and control the game until victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive playstyle with the ability to repeatedly "blink" creatures for value. By utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp, players can constantly return creatures to the battlefield to gain advantage. The deck also includes powerful removal spells like Fatal Push and Solitude to control the board. With a mix of creatures with powerful abilities and ways to protect them, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly while maintaining tempo and board presence.

This deck focuses on aggressive creature plays with strong removal and burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. With a mix of efficient creatures like Guide of Souls and Orcish Bowmasters, along with powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with constant pressure. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help control the board, while cards like Goblin Bombardment and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury provide additional reach to finish off the opponent. The deck also includes versatile spells like Thraben Charm and Galvanic Discharge for added flexibility.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize a combination of disruptive counterspells, efficient card draw, and powerful combo pieces to win the game without the need for traditional lands. By carefully managing resources and using cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Thundertrap Trainer, the deck aims to quickly assemble its win conditions and overwhelm opponents with unexpected plays. The inclusion of Hydroelectric Specimen and Tameshi, Reality Architect provides additional utility and consistency to ensure the deck can execute its game plan effectively.

This Esper Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of counterspells, hand disruption, and targeted removal. The deck aims to control the game by denying the opponent resources and answering threats efficiently. It utilizes cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Negation to disrupt the opponent's hand, while also managing the board with Fatal Push and Counterspell. Murktide Regent provides a powerful threat while Psychic Frog and Abhorrent Oculus offer utility and card advantage. The mana base is designed to facilitate casting the deck's spells consistently.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo using cards like Glaring Fleshraker, Basking Broodscale, and Blade of the Bloodchief to generate a massive amount of damage in a single turn. By using cards like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy, as well as cards like Urza's Saga and Eldrazi Temple to ramp up mana quickly, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a swift and devastating combo finish. The inclusion of cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Cavern of Souls helps to protect key pieces of the combo from counterspells and disruption.
